chapter_title: There is no Joy that shall remain in the World til

6.content: and fetter it in the lump

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** There is no soul dwelling in the natural mind , held fast in that state where good and evil are com mingled, for whom spiritual b lessedness end ures without interru ption.

**¶2:** Not only human minds — even Divine Love and Divine Truth themselves , the very sources of all wisdom and understanding in the heav ens, though they are not overcome and cannot be dimin ished, being established etern ally in the Divine calling and in perfect Divine order — even they do not possess complete joy.

**¶3:** The first cause is this : Their understanding perce ives the power of evil itself ; they see it and be hold its de formed fals ities. They see that self -love is alive and established and re igns over both the interior mind and the exterior mind , in hidden intention and in out ward act alike . It does everything according to its own will, which is the will of the prop rium.

**¶4:** The second cause: They perceive the celest ial life that the Lord has implanted within every human being; they see it, and they see that it is ensnared and held capt ive in a great bond age throughout both the interior and the exterior nature — imprisoned in perv erted perception and in the corpor eal prop rium — subjected to every violation . It is prof aned, drawn toward evil , divided and consumed as it passes between the interior and the exterior — from the celest ial down into the natural and from the natural back toward the celestial. It is stripped of its good and driven from one external state to another.

**¶5 :** Now, because this celestial life within humanity is loved by Divine Love and Divine Truth and is precious to them, when they be hold it in such violation they cannot possess complete joy.

**¶6 :** Thus one grief is for the celest ial life held capt ive; and one grief is for the power of evil, which they see ruling over what does not belong to it . Self -love is ex alted and satisfied with goods and truths it has stolen and prof aned. Because of this, Divine Love and Divine Truth do not rejoice fully , but end ure and contain the grief of their love until they purify the celestial life and rescue it from the domin ion of evil. Then they abol ish spiritual death, which is their advers ary, and they gather all evil together and conf ine it in its own fixed boundary forever .

**¶7:** When at the last they have bound the power of evil in eternal restra int, then they will rejoice and gr ieve no longer from that time. And they become wholly what they were from the beginning — restored to the full ness of Divine order , forever .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There is not [o]ne person [existing in] the world, standing firm [i]n mixture, for whom joy remains to the end.

Not only people, even the Sun and the Moon, the light-givers of the heavens, [they are not diminished] nor are they oppressed, they know not [grief, being s]et firm in a summons and an [obe]dience. Nevertheless, they too, they do not rejoice completely.

So, one: Their eyes stare at their Enemy, they [perceiv]e him and also look at his ugly shapes. They [s]ee him, that he is alive and established and is king above and below, in secret and manifest. He does every thing that he wants according to his wil[l].

[The s]econd: They perceive the Living Soul, they see [i]t and that it is ensnared and set in a great [fetter] above and below, in the tree and in the flesh, [and it is afflicted] with every oppression. It is being pressed, drawn near to [and] sliced and eaten as it comes up and down; from above below and from below above. It [is] despoiled and moved from body to body.
Now, because of their Living Soul that is loved by them and honoured of them, when they see it in oppression th[ey can] not [re]joice completely.

So, one about the soul; and one about their Enemy whom they see ruling [in] what is not his own. He is proud and satisfied with a wealth that is not his own. Indeed, due to this, they do not rejoice in total; but bear up and swallow their heart until they cleanse the Living Soul and take it from the Enemy's hands. Then they obliterate the Death that is their enemy and they gather it in [and fetter it in the lump] for ever and ever.
When they will chain their Enemy in the bond at the [las]t, then they will rejoice and no longer grieve from this t[ime]. Also, they become the very same as they were from the [start] for ever!

fills.fill: and fetter it in the lump
